title: New Meta Ads Paid Partnership Update 🚨
description: New Meta Ads Paid Partnership Update 🚨
transcript: Meta ads just dropped. One of the craziest updates for brands. You can now run ads from people who already have tagged your product. That means if a creator customer influencer ever posted about your brand and tagged you, you can now turn that content into a paid partnership ad instantly. Here's how it works go to Partnership Hub, click content, and meta will literally show you the posts that have featured your product in a video or image. You can now see who posted it, you can see whether you have usage rights or not. And if you don't have rights yet, you just click request directly from the creator and once they approve it, you can launch that exact post as a paid partnership ad inside a meta ads manager. This is massive because most brands are constantly trying to create new ads from scratch. But now you can go back through your entire history of tag content and turn existing post into ads. Customer post, creator videos, influencer content, product tags, organic mentions, all of it becomes a potential paid partnership ad. This is one of the lowest hanging creative opportunities on meta right now. You do not need to wait for a new shoot. You do not need to brief 50 new creators. You do not need to guess what feels native right now. You can find content that literally already exist, request rights, and start testing. The brands that move the fastest on this are Going to have a massive creative volume advantage, because the game in 2027 is not just better ads, it's more angles, more formats, more creators, and more content. In the account comment partnership, and I'll show you exactly how the strategy works.
